name: T1K+
description: A database of color texture images intended for benchmarking color texture classification and retrieval methods.
evaluation_method: classification accuracy for recognition tasks; retrieval metrics such as mean Average Precision (mAP) and precision@k for retrieval tasks
typical_sota_score: varies by problem formulation and features; often high for classical methods (e.g., >85%) but dataset-dependent
reputation: A specialized dataset used in color/texture research; moderate adoption within texture analysis literature but not a mainstream vision benchmark.
notes: Relatively small and specialized dataset for texture research; not an LLM benchmark; results sensitive to preprocessing and color-space choices; limited diversity compared to large-scale vision datasets.
